discovery.title: Grand Canyon flash flood leaves one dead, around 15 missing
discovery.summary: At least one person was killed and about 15 others were missing after a flash flood at the Grand Canyon, one of the most popular tourist sites in the United States, the National Park Service said in a statement Sunday.
